subtitle: Offline voting (UniFFI → rust-core)

country.label: Country code
country.hint: Two letters, like US, NP or BR.
country.serverHint: Sent to the server as the X-Debug-Country header (development only).

location.primingTitle: Fill in your country from your location?
location.primingBody: TRAN can read your approximate location once to find your country, so it picks the right voting age. Your location is not kept or sent anywhere. This is optional: you can type the country yourself.
location.purpose: TRAN uses your approximate location once to find your country and pick the right voting age. It is optional; you can type the country instead.
location.settingsNote: Location is off for TRAN. Type your country, or turn location on in Settings.

offlineNotice: API unreachable — using offline rules mirrored from Rust Core.

result.label: Result
result.sourceFallback: The server could not answer — checked on this device.
result.reasonMeets: Age {age} meets the minimum voting age of {minimumAge} in {country}.
result.reasonBelow: Age {age} is below the minimum voting age of {minimumAge} in {country}.
